appDescription: An automatic corporate vehicle logbook that records gear and odometer based trips, their business purposes and driving expenses.

function.name: SET_TRIP_PURPOSE
function.description: Set the purpose and an optional note of the current trip or the most recently completed trip within twelve hours.

purpose.description: Trip purpose category used for the business use ratio.

note.description: Additional trip remark of up to 200 characters, appended to the existing note up to 300 characters in total.

function.name: ADD_TRIP_EXPENSE
function.description: Record a driving expense on the current trip or the most recently completed trip within twelve hours, without performing payment.

expenseType.description: Category of the driving expense; fuel includes charging expenses.

amount.description: Whole expense amount in Korean won, from 1 to 10000000.

function.name: GET_DRIVING_LOG_SUMMARY
function.description: Report trip and business distances, registered expense totals and categories, review counts and configured mileage reimbursement estimates for a period.
